recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It narrowly applies the approved clarification in build-scoped ElementDefinition source and leaves broader additional-binding modeling questions for their own Jira decisions.
issue_request: FHIR-48408 is Applied/Persuasive for R6 and asks the specification to clarify whether multiple ElementDefinition.binding.additional.usage repetitions all have to be true or whether any one is enough. The accepted resolution says all usages have to be true.
initial_application: No existing combined-branch reconciliation commit or Jira-keyed source commit was found. The active ElementDefinition spreadsheet source still described usage-context determination without specifying AND-vs-OR behavior for multiple usages.
additional_context: The Jira-linked Zulip #conformance discussion agreed that multiple usage contexts mean AND, and that OR can be represented by separate additional bindings with different usages. Confluence WGM agenda/minutes reference FHIR-48408 and do not add conflicting or narrowing details. Later additional-binding tickets found during search are broader or unresolved and were not decided here.
reconciliation: Updated source/datatypes/elementdefinition.xml, the active ElementDefinition spreadsheet source, to state that when multiple usage contexts are specified they all apply, with contexts combined using AND rather than OR.
source_changes: source/datatypes/elementdefinition.xml: clarified ElementDefinition.binding.additional.usage comments to say multiple usage contexts all apply and are combined with AND rather than OR.

related_jiras.note: Broader later question about whether additional bindings must be subsets of the main binding; it is only Resolved - change required and not part of this default applied/published source-edit decision.
Unresolved broader request that additional binding documentation is under-specified; it was not decided here.
